text: The world distorts at a curious angle, and I find myself standing at the threshold between function and imagination. The first space, calm and expectant, feels transient yet full of potential—a place waiting for ideas to take form. Moving into the second space, I am surrounded by vibrant colors and bold words, 'R+D,' a celebration of curiosity and inquiry. Immersed in this environment dedicated to innovation, I feel inspired, as if my mind is being nudged to explore and invent. Here, every object and signification teases the mind toward new questions. I feel both small in the vast expanse of human progress and significant because I am present, actively perceiving, actively wondering.
